end_to_end.input: An immutable source commit introduces a workflow that validates a command and emits Issue #2 job comments.
steps: P1 locate source delta
P2 split trigger, validation, write side effect into atomic claims
P3 classify component/interface/relationship separately
P4 resolve identities against current registry
P5 choose CREATE for new component and AUGMENT for known interface when evidence supports it
P6 write distinct typed proposals
P7 validate source commit and request approval for Issue #8 changes
P8 checkpoint proposals as deferred until review
end_to_end.lesson: One document yields multiple atomic record types, never an unbounded essay.

end_to_end.input: Documentation says transfer implies completion, but an immutable job status is running after transfer.
steps: P1 identify affected documented claim and job receipt
P2 decompose transfer and execution as separate assertions
P3 classify state_transition and operational_observation
P4 align times/scopes
P5 revise conceptual distinction or flag CONFLICT if truly same scope
P6 cite instruction and current record
P7 prohibit unreviewed replacement of existing context
P8 checkpoint open evidence question
end_to_end.lesson: Never equate queue transfer, job execution and completion without independent proof.

end_to_end.input: A new mechanism coordinates turns across agents but has no valid category-specific payload shape.
steps: P1 capture immutable reference
P2 atomize behavior without fitting a favored concept
P3 test inclusion and exclusion criteria for all nine types
P4 record unmatched dimensions
P5 choose DEFER with unclassified proposal rather than forcing taxonomy
P6 propose ontology definition, 3 contrastive shots and tests
P7 request versioned schema review
P8 checkpoint missing ontology category
end_to_end.lesson: Novel information leads to a schema-extension proposal, not silent malformed registry JSON.
